c6_microarchitecture_boundary.finding: The frozen C6 HLS source has INLINE/BIND_STORAGE/interface directives but no explicit HLS PIPELINE or UNROLL directives on the dominant Argon fill or RW5 step loops.
c6_microarchitecture_boundary.implication: C6 PPA is a real correctness/portability implementation point, not a competent-specialist optimum and not an ASIC lower bound.

calibrated_logic_points.timing_boundary: Approximate only; derived from 2ns requested clock plus partial-global-route setup deficit. Not final report_clock_min_period or signoff.

hbm4_36gb_context_model.vendor_bandwidth_ceiling_work_s: ~3406-5057 from RP-B2; not achieved DP6 throughput

area_interpretation.conclusion: For an external-memory attacker, logic replication is not presently supported as the dominant area/capex burden. Full-state on-die SRAM remains area-expensive.

strongest_plausible_attacker.memory: HBM4/HBM3E or GDDR7 full-state external memory
strongest_plausible_attacker.compute: fewer shared or selectively replicated Argon/BlaMka and microcoded/fixed-function RW5 engines
strongest_plausible_attacker.optimization: lower-voltage/lower-frequency where J/work improves; no requirement to maximize clock
strongest_plausible_attacker.cache: small SRAM hot structures only; not full state unless area economics justify

unresolved: achieved DP6 random dependent HBM/GDDR service efficiency
